desc: The CZ DUTY is engineered for consistent control. Its cold hammer-forged barrel, durable nitride finish, rugged frame, enhanced slide serrations, and fully ambidextrous controls are designed to withstand demanding use and changing conditions. Three interchangeable grip modules provide a secure, personalized fit, while the redesigned interface allows a wide range of standardized red dot footprints to mount directly to the slide using the included pin system.
